marberg_section_clarification: The corroborating equations (2.2)–(2.3) are in Section 2.3, PDF pages 5–6. Section 2.2 on page 5 records equality of the one-sided orbit sizes.
mathematical_dependencies: Standard two-sided-orbit conventional supercharacters are characters with disjoint, exhaustive irreducible supports.
Additive Fourier orthogonality and the ordinary regular-character irreducible expansion.
Invertible linear two-sided action on the dual algebra.
excluded_dependency: The Diaconis–Thiem v1 page 7 unweighted regular-sum wording is not used.
